description: TfL publishes an extract of red-route controls from its Metros traffic-order system. The schema identifies orders, enforcement zones, street locations, prohibitions, applicable days and times, exemptions and start/end locations. Coverage is limited to permanent and selected long-term temporary orders that TfL enforces. The source excludes most borough bays, clearway exemptions/routes and rapid-charge locations. The documented extract runs weekly; actual current restrictions were not checked. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The item states TfL as-is terms without identifying a standard reuse licence. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
